Messages.Author: Mark
Messages.Body:
If a younger minion of mine is blocking another (older) minion, and I
manage to get the other to torpor, and I play Amaranth, can I get a
skillcard?

Since officially I am not acting, and the rulebook says:

3. If the acting vampire is younger than the diablerized vampire, the
controlling Methuselah may go through her hand, library, and/or ash
heap to find a Discipline card to place on the acting vampire.

This under the subject of "How to resolve diablerie"...

Some confusion over that in our group...

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
On Jun 7, 9:50 am, Mark <markangel1...@gmail.com> wrote:
> If a younger minion of mine is blocking another (older) minion, and I
> manage to get the other to torpor, and I play Amaranth, can I get a
> skillcard?

Yes.

> Since officially I am not acting, and the rulebook says:
>
> 3. If the acting vampire is younger than the diablerized vampire, the
> controlling Methuselah may go through her hand, library, and/or ash
> heap to find a Discipline card to place on the acting vampire.
>
> This under the subject of "How to resolve diablerie"...

That's a quote from an old WotC-era rulebook.

From the current rulebook, section 6.5.5 "Diablerie":

4. If the victim was older (had a higher capacity) than the
diablerist, the diablerist can be given a Discipline. His controller
may go through her library, ash heap and hand to get a master
Discipline card to put on the diablerist and then reshuffle her
library or draw back up to her hand size as necessary. This may
increase the diablerist's capacity by 1, but does not automatically
give the diablerist a blood to fill that new capacity.

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#sec6_5_5
